response_json.case_goal: Add a new room to an existing area with specified attributes.
response_json.summary: The test logs into the MRBS admin panel, navigates to the Rooms management page, fills in room details (name, description, capacity, admin email), and submits the form to add the room.

steps.expected_result: Admin login page is displayed with username and password fields.
Admin panel is displayed with navigation links including 'Rooms'.
Rooms management page is shown with area selection and 'Add Room' form.
Room name field is filled with 'test room'.
Room description field is filled with 'test description'.
Admin email field is filled with 'test@admin.com'.
Room is added and page redirects to admin.php?area=2 showing the new room with Edit/Delete options.
